basic_details.job_title: Anna University Project Assistant/Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Civil Engineering, University College of Engineering (BIT Campus), Anna University, Tiruchirappalli, has invited applications from Indian Nationals for one Project Assistant/Fellow post in a research project funded under the Chief Minister's Research Grant (CMRG), Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE), Tamil Nadu. The monthly pay is Rs. 25,000/- (consolidated). The essential qualification is First Class in M.E./M.Tech. (Environmental Engineering / Environmental Management). Applicants must send the hard copy and soft copy of the application form on or before 23-11-2026 (M

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form given as Annexure-I of the notice. It asks for personal details with a recent passport size photo, educational background from S.S.L.C. onward, the qualifying examination (GATE/CSIR/UGC/NET/others), professional experience, research publications, awards and patents, and other relevant information, followed by a signed declaration.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates for educational qualification, date of birth, mark sheets, experience and any other academic credentials.
Send the hard copy to: Dr. V. Rajagopalan, Assistant Professor (Sl.Gr.), Department of Civil Engineering, University College of Engineering (BIT Campus), Anna University, Tiruchirappalli – 620 024.
Send the soft copy to the email id [email protected]. The phone number given is +91 9941316056.
Write on top of the cover: "Application for the post of Project Assistant – CMRG2400486".
Send the application on or before 23-11-2026 (Monday).
important_instructions: No TA/DA is admissible for candidates attending the interview. Any claim regarding qualification and experience should have necessary certificates. The application form declaration says Anna University BIT Campus may cancel the application or selection if any discrepancy is found at any stage. The declaration also states that the application is only for a temporary position.

rows.details: Anna University, University College of Engineering (BIT Campus), Tiruchirappalli
Climate-Resilient Agriculture: AI-Powered Soil Health Monitoring with Advanced Multimodal Sensors
Chief Minister's Research Grant (CMRG), Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE), Tamil Nadu
Total duration of the project is 1 Year and 6 Months
Hard copy by post to the address given, and soft copy by email

content_sections.heading: About Anna University BIT Campus Project
content_sections.text: The post is in the University College of Engineering (BIT Campus) of Anna University, Tiruchirappalli. It serves a research project under Principal Investigator Dr. V. Rajagopalan, Assistant Professor (Sl.Gr.), Department of Civil Engineering. The project is sanctioned under CMRG Proceedings No. CMRG / 3005 / H3 / 2024 / 046 dated 16-07-2025, and the Project ID printed on the application form is CMRG2400486.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian Nationals only. GATE/NET qualified candidates will be given preference. If suitable candidates are not found in the GATE/NET category, Non GATE / Non NET candidates will be considered. The notice prints no experience requirement and no age limit. For the full eligibility, refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: First Class in M.E./M.Tech. (Environmental Engineering / Environmental Management) from a recognized University or Equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly salary is Rs. 25,000/- (Consolidated). The position is temporary and will be renewed every year subject to satisfactory performance. The total duration of the project is 1 Year and 6 Months. Selected candidates will be permitted to register for the Ph.D program as per Anna University, Chennai Rules and Regulations.

content_sections.heading: Anna University Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To execute the research work detailed in the entitled project Compilation of the results Report preparation and presentation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Anna University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form given as Annexure-I of the notice. It asks for personal details with a recent passport size photo, educational background from S.S.L.C. onward, the qualifying examination (GATE/CSIR/UGC/NET/others), professional experience, research publications, awards and patents, and other relevant information, followed by a signed declaration. Attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates for educational qualification, date of birth, mark sheets, experience and any other academic credentials. Send the hard copy to: Dr. V. Rajagopalan, Assistant Professor (Sl.Gr.), Department of Civil Engineering, University College of Engineering (BIT Campus), Anna University, Tiruchirappalli – 620 024. Send the soft copy to the email id [email protected] . The phone number given is +91 9941316056. Write on top of the cover: "Application for the post of Project Assistant – CMRG2400486". Send the application on or before 23-11-2026 (Monday).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for interview. The interview date will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates by E-mail only. The decision of the selection committee is final. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is admissible for candidates attending the interview. Any claim regarding qualification and experience should have necessary certificates. The application form declaration says Anna University BIT Campus may cancel the application or selection if any discrepancy is found at any stage. The declaration also states that the application is only for a temporary position.

Anna University BIT Campus Project Assistant/Fellow notice dated 12.11.2026

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant/Fellow posts are vacant at Anna University BIT Campus?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 position of Project Assistant/Fellow.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 23-11-2026 (Monday).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for this post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is First Class in M.E./M.Tech. (Environmental Engineering / Environmental Management) from a recognized University or Equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Project Assistant/Fellow?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs. 25,000/- (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send both the hard copy and the soft copy of the filled-in Annexure-I form. The hard copy goes to Dr. V. Rajagopalan at the Department of Civil Engineering, UCE (BIT Campus), Tiruchirappalli – 620 024. The soft copy goes to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Who is called for the interview?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates are called, and the interview date is communicated by e-mail only.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is temporary and will be renewed every year subject to satisfactory performance. The total project duration is 1 Year and 6 Months.

faq.question: Q8. Do GATE/NET qualified candidates get preference?
faq.answer: Yes. GATE/NET qualified candidates will be given preference. Non GATE / Non NET candidates will be considered only if suitable candidates are not found in that category.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is admissible for candidates attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the selected candidate register for a Ph.D?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates will be permitted to register for the Ph.D program as per Anna University, Chennai Rules and Regulations.
